limitations: Phone browser viewport simulation, not physical Android touch hardware.
Known-source real Phemex success tested. Legacy source selection and unsupported feed handling covered by source review and request fixtures, not every exchange live.
Backend adapter configuration may reject spot feeds; chart does not silently replace them with perpetual data.
Outstanding read-only candle HTTP requests may finish after closing; stale responses cannot update removed or replacement charts.
Latest candles may be cached/closed; last-bar timestamp is shown. Saved setup levels are not automatically refreshed or requalified.
